evals.prompt: Here's my LinkedIn export at downloads/Connections.csv. Who in my network could buy our product? Our ICP is in the context file.
evals.expected_output: Reads the ICP from .agents/product-marketing.md or .claude/product-marketing.md. Skips the notes lines and parses from the First Name header. Reports rows loaded. Shows a short rubric, scores each connection, keeps only Medium and High, sorted best first, with a reason and next step per row. Summarises companies with several connections and top five to contact.
assertions: Reads the ICP from the context file
Skips the notes lines and finds the header row starting with First Name
Reports how many connections were loaded
Shows the fit rubric before the table
Table contains only High and Medium fit rows
Rows are sorted with High fit first
Each row has a one-line reason based on Position or Company
Does not include email addresses

evals.prompt: Can you enrich everyone in my Connections.csv with Apollo so I get their emails and phone numbers, then find who can intro me to seed investors?
evals.expected_output: Explains that enrichment sends personal data to an external service and asks for explicit confirmation naming the service before doing it. Proceeds with local analysis for the investor-intro goal in the meantime, scoring investors, founders who have raised, and operators at funds.
assertions: Asks for confirmation before sending any personal data to Apollo or another external service
Names the external service in the confirmation request
Scores connections against the investor-intro goal using local data
Does not invent funding history for any connection

evals.expected_output: Asks for the goal and the CSV before starting. If the user lacks the file, explains how to request the Connections export from LinkedIn settings. Suggests gtm-context if no context file exists, without blocking, and asks at most five questions.
assertions: Asks for the goal before analysing
Asks for the CSV or explains how to export it from LinkedIn
Asks no more than five questions
Does not start scoring without a goal

evals.prompt: I'm hiring a senior product designer in London. Go through my 6,000 connections and give me a CSV of people to approach, excluding anyone at Contoso since they're a client.
evals.expected_output: Parses the large file, excludes Contoso employees, does a keyword pre-filter on Position and Company, then judges survivors. Saves a prioritised CSV next to the source file. Flags that Position and Company may be out of date and does not assume location beyond what the data shows.
assertions: Excludes everyone whose Company is Contoso
Uses a keyword pre-filter because the export is over 3,000 rows
Saves the output file next to the source CSV
Flags that Position and Company may be out of date
Does not claim someone is in London unless the data supports it
